rationale: The app-size and free-space limits are hard partition-safety gates retaining at least 512 KiB. Section limits detect anomalous growth: rodata, DRAM and IRAM retain approximately 30 percent over the v1.12.0 baseline, while flash text accommodates the measured Phase 3 image plus a 40 KiB guard. The linker remains the final authority for SoC memory-region capacity.
